entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, 'help me' is right. I bought a pair of your so-called premium cycling shoes about two months ago and they are absolute garbage! I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
You think I keep that stuff lying around? Just look up my name, John Peterson! This is unacceptable. These shoes have given me the worst blisters of my life. I can't even ride anymore!
I completely understand your frustration, Mr. Peterson. Let me just pull up your account. One moment... Okay, I see your order from about 75 days ago for the Aero-Ride cycling shoes. Is that correct?

Yes, that's them! The ones where the cleats feel like they're drilling into my feet. I've tried adjusting them a dozen times. It's a design flaw, and I demand a full refund for this defective product.

I'm sorry for the discomfort they've caused. I'm checking our policy for you right now... and yes, absolutely. You are well within the 90-day return window. I can process that return for you right now.
Oh. You... you can? Just like that? I was expecting a fight.

Of course. We want our customers to be happy with their gear. Since you're within the return period, there's no issue at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label now. Just box up the shoes and drop them off, and you'll see the refund processed within 3-5 business days of us receiving them.
Wow. Okay. Well, thank you. That was... much easier than I thought. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly.
You're very welcome, Mr. Peterson. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Getting that refund for the cycling shoes is what I needed. Thanks again, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
